---
format:
  pdf:
    documentclass: article
    pdf-engine: lualatex
    geometry:
      - letterpaper
      - margin=0in
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        \usepackage{graphicx}
        \pagestyle{empty}
        \setlength{\parindent}{0pt}
        \setlength{\fboxsep}{0pt}
        \setlength{\fboxrule}{0.3pt}
        \newcommand{\cardpage}[2]{%
          \null\vfill
          \begin{center}
          {\footnotesize\sffamily #2}\par\vspace{6pt}
          \fbox{\includegraphics[page=#1,width=5in,height=3in]{notecard-3x5.pdf}}\par
          \vspace{6pt}{\footnotesize\sffamily Cut along the box. Print at 100\% / Actual size.}
          \end{center}
          \vfill\null}
---

```{=latex}
\cardpage{1}{FRONT}
\newpage
\cardpage{2}{BACK}
```
